title: Jinsi ya kutambua saluni nzuri: angalia viti vya kuoshea nywele
label: Chagua saluni nzuri

text.Choosing a hair salon is pretty hard, ri: Kuchagua saluni ya nywele ni vigumu kiasi, sivyo?
text.The usual way is to choose a hairdresser: Kwa kawaida huchagua mtengeneza nywele mwenye wafuasi wengi mitandaoni.
text.If you look at the salon itself, it seem: Ni vizuri kukagua viti vya kuoshea nywele katika saluni yenyewe.
text.The price range of shampoo chairs is ver: Bei hutofautiana sana, na baadhi ya viti ni ghali mno.
text.She said a salon that spends money there: Alisema saluni inayotumia pesa kwa viti hivyo inaaminika zaidi kidogo.
text.✂️ Thinning scissors: ✂️ Mkasi wa kupunguza unene wa nywele
text.On the other hand, be careful of salons: Jihadhari na saluni zinazomalizia kwa kupunguza nywele haraka kwa mkasi maalumu.
text.According to my hairdresser, that can so: Kulingana na mtengeneza nywele wangu, wakati mwingine hiyo inaweza kuficha kazi isiyofanywa vizuri.
text.Korean idols push their bangs up but lea: Mastaa wa K-pop huinua nywele za mbele na kuacha nyuzi chache pembeni ili uso uonekane mdogo
